title: Russian-Style Pasta Baked with Intense Resinous Flavor
description: A unique pasta dish featuring resinous notes from pine resin and a hint of Russian spices. This baked goodness is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: 2. Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
3. In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
4. Add the ground pine resin to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushrooms. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
5. Add the cubed Russian black bread to the skillet and toss to combine with the mushroom-pine resin mixture.
6. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, mushroom-bread mixture, dill, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
7. Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with grated cheese.
8. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
